paper-white.$description: Paper White — Primary page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills

warm-parchment.$description: Warm Parchment — Alternate section surface — gives the cream/ivory warmth that stops the page from feeling clinical

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, dark feature card surfaces, filled pill button background, hairline borders — the structural backbone of every screen

soft-graphite.$description: Soft Graphite — Secondary text, muted helper copy, quiet borders on neutral sections

mid-ash.$description: Mid Ash — Tertiary metadata, section subtitles, low-emphasis text

pale-mist.$description: Pale Mist — Disabled badge fill, very low-emphasis surface washes

broadcast-gradient.$description: Broadcast Gradient — Signature accent — used only for product screenshot frames, feature pill backgrounds, and the one full-width section wash; the gradient itself carries the brand voice, so the orange leading stop represents it in solid form

geist.$description: Sole typeface across nav, body, headings, and buttons. Weight 400 carries body and most copy; weight 500 is reserved for subheadings, labels, and emphasis. The Geist stylistic sets ss01, ss03, ss04 are enabled — these alter the alternate single-storey 'a', the geometric 'g', and the modernist '$' to give the type a custom editorial feel. Substitute with Inter at the same weights if Geist is unavailable.
